answer: A harbor-style admission gate makes each agent identity post a refundable stake that stays locked through a glacier-slow cooldown before it can trade, so a Sybil farm must tie up real capital per fake identity instead of spawning free copies. Honest agents earn the stake back through real work, while the nebula of throwaway identities around them stays expensive to maintain and easy to spot, because every fake carries a visible, time-locked cost.
